children: Flyte Aviation announced a multi-year partnership as the Official Private Aviation Partner of the Philadelphia 76ers.
Signed exclusive multi-year deal to become the Philadelphia 76ers' Official Private Aviation Partner.
Partnership will activate across digital, social, premium hospitality, fan engagement and corporate channels.
Provides Flyte direct access to 76ers fans, season-ticket members, premium customers and corporate partners.
Plans include in-arena activations and promotions, such as a halftime challenge awarding a private Flyte flight.
Deal aligns with Flyte’s AI-driven platform strategy to expand its Northeast footprint and broaden private aviation access.
